title: SHA-1 selected by name (csharp) — review required
description: Security code in csharp selects SHA-1 by algorithm name: SHA1.Creates*(s*). Collision attacks ended SHA-1's suitability for signatures and integrity. This lexical rule flags the selection; the reviewer confirms the use is legacy interop or upgrades it.
remediation: Select SHA256.Create() instead of SHA-1 for any security purpose.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the SHA-1 name regardless of purpose. Call-shaped SHA-1 uses are separate rules.
